stock.description: Operating as an investment holding company, Somerley Capital Holdings Limited delivers corporate finance advisory and asset management solutions across Hong Kong. The firm offers financial advisory expertise to a broad spectrum of clients, including publicly traded entities in Hong Kong, their diverse shareholder base, and potential investors. This also extends to entities aiming to gain control or make investments in Hong Kong-listed businesses, alongside serving independent board committees and/or independent shareholders of such companies. Furthermore, Somerley Capital serves as a compliance advisor, predominantly for newly listed companies within Hong Kong. Its capabilities also encompass sponsoring initial public offerings (IPOs) and subsequent share listings on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. The company provides crucial guidance on cross-border mergers and acquisitions (M&A) and advises on secondary equity offerings. Additionally, the company extends its advisory support to international clientele seeking to engage in investment and divestment activities involving enterprises in Mainland China. Its comprehensive suite of advisory services further encompasses takeovers of listed entities, connected transactions, privatizations, IPOs, whitewash waivers, and subsequent share issues. It also guides clients through acquisitions and disposals, corporate spin-offs and reorganizations, and ensures adherence to the Hong Kong listing rules. The diverse range of sectors it serves includes conglomerates, consumer goods, industrial, renewables, energy, natural resources, infrastructure, financial institutions, insurance, property, construction, gaming, hospitality, and technology, media, and telecommunications. Established in 2016, the company maintains its headquarters in Central, Hong Kong, and operates as a subsidiary of Somerley Group Limited.
